title: Preserving Food
description: Covers sun, air, and fire drying and making jerky, salt curing with a basic cure mix, smoking with an improvised smoker, quick pickling, and fermenting sauerkraut. Also explains root cellaring, canning without power, and the spoilage signs to watch for.
shortDescription: Drying, jerky, salt curing, smoking, pickling, and root cellars
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
